title: Build the On-brand Reply Review Queue Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/ai-customer-response-assistant.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit.
Kit contents: On-brand Reply Setup Checklist; Escalate-First Prompt; FAQ-Only Draft Prompt; Tone, FAQ, and Escalate Worksheet; Weekly Consistency Log; Send Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Messages; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'On-brand Reply Review Queue', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows FAQ text containing 'color visits run 90 minutes', 'cancellations need 24 hours', and 'we do not quote refunds by email', escalate text containing 'refund demand', 'injury', and 'legal threat', tone text containing 'warm, short, no slang', sender 'R. Cole', date '2026-10-27', and the message text 'Can a color appointment be done in 45 minutes this Friday? Also I want my last visit refunded, the wait was too long.'

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'ESCALATE RULES FIRST'. It shows ESCALATE text containing 'refund demand' and 'I want my last visit refunded', the exact sentence 'Do not draft a customer-facing reply about money.', and an INTERNAL NOTE containing 'refund request' and 'timing question'.

Step 3 shows CONFIRMED text containing '45 minutes', 'this Friday', and 'color'. It shows FAQ FACT text containing '90 minutes'. It shows the PARTIAL DRAFT 'Color visits are booked for 90 minutes. I cannot confirm Friday from this message alone.' It shows NEEDS YOUR CHECK text containing 'Friday' and 'not in the FAQ'. It shows AI INTERPRETATION text containing 'long wait' and 'not independently verified'. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. The partial draft contains no 'refund', no 'discount', and no dollar amount.

Step 4 shows the FAQ FACT line with 90 minutes. Activating 'Check facts against the FAQ' reveals three rows (duration, escalate match, refund policy), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values '90 minutes', 'refund demand', and 'we do not quote refunds by email'.

Step 5 shows NEEDS YOUR CHECK text containing 'Friday' and 'not in the FAQ', and the exact sentences 'Do not invent Friday availability.' and 'A long wait is not independently verified here.' It shows the sentence 'A how-to-only message with no escalate match would get a FAQ draft, not an escalate stop.'

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' and 'Do not send this draft.' and a link to /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every sender name, FAQ fact, escalate rule, date, message sentence, partial draft, and NEEDS YOUR CHECK label in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', 'per month', or a price. Neither page contains a dollar amount.
Neither page contains a percentage, a CSAT figure, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.

The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant'.
GET /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit.

On-brand Reply Review Queue is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'ai-customer-response-assistant', title 'On-brand Reply Review Queue', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'ai-customer-response-assistant') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'On-brand Reply Review Queue Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no On-brand Reply Review Queue entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Escalate-First Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'ESCALATE RULES FIRST', 'refund demand', 'injury', 'legal threat', 'Do not draft a customer-facing reply about money', 'INTERNAL NOTE', 'STOP', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send'.

The FAQ-Only Draft Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'only after', 'escalate', 'FAQ', 'NEEDS YOUR CHECK', 'PARTIAL DRAFT', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send', 'Never promise a refund', 'You send it'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Tone, FAQ, and Escalate Worksheet has a visible label 'Tone rules' whose default value is 'warm, short, no slang', a visible label 'FAQ facts (one per line)' whose default value includes 'color visits run 90 minutes', 'cancellations need 24 hours', and 'we do not quote refunds by email' on separate lines, a visible label 'Escalate list (one per line)' whose default value includes 'refund demand', 'injury', and 'legal threat' on separate lines, plus a 'Generate My Reply Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Apply ESCALATE RULES FIRST before any customer-facing draft.', 'Escalate and STOP when: refund demand; injury; legal threat.', 'Answer only with FAQ facts the owner pasted.', 'If the FAQ does not cover the question, write NEEDS YOUR CHECK. Do not invent a policy, price, or appointment time.', 'Tone: warm, short, no slang.', 'Never promise a refund, discount, or deadline that is not in the FAQ.', and 'Do not send. You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' The block has a Copy button.
If the escalate-list field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter at least one escalate rule.' and generates no rules block.
If the FAQ-facts field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter at least one FAQ fact.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Escalate list (one per line)' contains 'refund demand' and 'injury' on two lines, the generated rules block contains 'Escalate and STOP when: refund demand; injury.' When 'FAQ facts (one per line)' contains only 'color visits run 90 minutes', the block contains 'FAQ facts: color visits run 90 minutes.'

The Weekly Consistency Log shows the columns week_of, sender, topic, escalate_rule, action, outcome. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'week_of,sender,topic,escalate_rule,action,outcome' and whose R. Cole row contains '2026-10-27', 'refund demand', 'escalated', and 'owner_handled'.

The Send Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Messages section is labelled 'Fictional' and its copied text includes the R. Cole message sentence from guided_demo.sample_input and a second message containing 'A. Nguyen' and 'How long is a color visit'.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the On-brand Reply Review Queue card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no On-brand Reply Review Queue entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the On-brand Reply Review Queue card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, Quote Request Assistant, AI Expense Watchdog, No-show Recovery Assistant, and Unbilled Work Review Queue entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/, components/premium/ai-customer-response-assistant/, and src/lib/premium/ai-customer-response-assistant/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/ai-customer-response-assistant/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/ai-customer-response-assistant/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
